stem.text: Two neutral atoms are isotopes of the same element.
Which statement about the atoms is correct?

A.text: They have a different number of neutrons and a different number of electrons.

B.text: They have a different number of neutrons and the same number of protons.

C.text: They have the same number of neutrons and a different number of electrons.

D.text: They have the same number of neutrons and the same number of protons.
